title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — if punished loco with original-sin penalty, we should not receive the same
pass_a_gloss: If the original-sin penalty already fell on Adam loco nostro, we should not also receive it—loco sin and loco punishment travel together.
pass_b_english: For if he was chastised in our place with that penalty which is original sin, it does not fit that we should be afflicted with the same penalty: for as he sinned in our place, so he was punished in our place.
source_text: Nam si loco nostro ea poena castigatus fuit quae est peccatum originale, non convenit nos eadem poena affici: quam enim loco nostro peccavit, tam loco nostro punitus est.

choices.choice: Loco original on Adam blocks same on us

notes: Cap. IX missa/poena densify section 643 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 354–355 tip).
